2026_01_WAS_PHI.headline: Washington’s healthier edge group gets a difficult assignment against Philadelphia’s run-pass balance
2026_01_WAS_PHI.paragraph1: Washington expects Odafe Oweh, K’Lavon Chaisson and Jacory Croskey-Merritt to be available, giving the Commanders more flexibility for a divisional opener that requires pressure without losing contain. Philadelphia is missing Jonathan Greenard, but Jalen Hurts and Saquon Barkley still force defenses to defend the full width of the field. Washington needs disciplined rush lanes and sound early-down run defense, while the Eagles can create favorable play-action and coverage conflicts if Barkley keeps them ahead of schedule.
